name: Ironhead
summary: Ironhead; You gain advantage on checks to mine, breach, salvage, demolish, or repair machinery and structures.  Ironhead; Your attacks against objects, vehicles, and machines deal +1d8 damage.  Ironhead; Once per short rest, when you damage an object, vehicle, or machine, treat the hit as a critical hit.  Ironhead; Your attacks against machines, vehicles, and structures ignore resistance once per turn.
descriptionMarkdown:
Ironhead; You gain advantage on checks to mine, breach, salvage, demolish, or repair machinery and structures.

Ironhead; Your attacks against objects, vehicles, and machines deal +1d8 damage.

Ironhead; Once per short rest, when you damage an object, vehicle, or machine, treat the hit as a critical hit.

Ironhead; Your attacks against machines, vehicles, and structures ignore resistance once per turn.
